done_when: Forge's review brief shows the previous round's findings and asks for every blocking gap at once; a test the story assigns to another task is an advisory Later finding; the end-to-end test rule applies to user-facing behaviour, not CI, config or test-only items; the edge-case rule sits with the blocking rules; Forge's bookkeeping files are left out of the out-of-scope list; the reviewer's checkout has readable git history; tests through forge close show each
why: Autoreview's brief from Forge makes reviews take extra rounds: findings arrive one round at a time, tests owned by a later task block, the end-to-end rule and edge cases block non-user items, Forge's own records show as out of scope, and the reviewer cannot read git history
